skipped_note: s1 rows are skipped when the source record carries no settlement_value_dollars (the payout is NOT derived from the yes/no result here — the scheduled run reads it from the market record itself); s2 rows are skipped when no later sample exists.

strategies.name: Momentum follow, hold to resolution
strategies.entry_rule: buy YES at the market's last traded price on the sample that triggered the >= $0.10 alert
strategies.exit_rule: hold until the API reports settlement_value_dollars ($1.00 if it resolves yes, $0.00 if no)

strategies.name: Momentum follow, flat at the next sample
strategies.exit_rule: exit at the next recorded sample of the same market (the tape's sampling interval, not a real order book)

disclaimer: Simulated trades on demo prices. Gross of fees, spread and slippage: the public API publishes no fee estimate for a hypothetical order, so none is assumed. Entry is a trade print, not a book quote — a real order would cross the spread. Not evidence of profitability.
